rules.statement: The testbench and reference model must be built independently of the generated RTL.
The RTL must not define expected results; expected results come from the independent reference model.

rules.condition: FIXED/INCR/WRAP bursts with legal sizes under CFG-BASE (TEST-001)
rules.statement: The independent model must match the bridge addresses, data and responses for FIXED, INCR and WRAP bursts with legal sizes.

rules.condition: During APB wait and RREADY/BREADY stalls (TEST-003)
rules.statement: Payload must remain stable through APB wait states and RREADY/BREADY stalls, checked by assertions.
